response.text: Several discrepancies to check: no voids, no unposted journals, and no 'V' status, though the dictionary lists them. Let me dig into the anomalies and the amount/date conventions.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'neg_inv' k, "INV_ID"::text a, "INV_AMT"::text b, "STAT_CD" c FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT" < 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'unbal_jrnl', "JRNL_NO"::text, SUM("DR_AMT")::text, SUM("CR_AMT")::text FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT") <> SUM("CR_AMT") UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_acct_line', "JRNL_NO"::text, "ACCT_CD", "DR_AMT"::text || '/' || "CR_AMT"::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_sample', "INV_ID"::text, "INV_DT"::text, "JRNL_NO"::text FROM (SELECT * FROM "APINVH" ORDER BY "INV_ID" LIMIT 3) s UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_sample', "PAY_ID"::text, "PAY_DT"::text, "PAY_AMT"::text FROM (SELECT * FROM "APPAYM" ORDER BY "PAY_ID" LIMIT 3) s UNION ALL SELECT 'period', "PRD_ID"::text, "STRT_DT"::text || '-' || "END_DT"::text, "STAT_CD" FROM "GLPERD" ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 12;

SELECT 'paid_inv_no_pay' k, COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_ne_amt', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND (SELECT SUM("PAY_AMT") FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") <> i."INV_AMT" UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_jrnl_src_not_AP', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH") AND h."SRC_CD"<>'AP' UNION ALL SELECT 'posted_jrnl_in_open_period', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='O' UNION ALL SELECT 'refjrnl_nonnull', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'date_range_inv', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_DT" NOT BETWEEN 19000101 AND 20991231 UNION ALL SELECT 'memo_sample_nonnull', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "MEMO" IS NOT NULL;
